verses.text: 1. A brother said to Abba Cronius, ’Speak a word to me.’ He said to him, ’When Elisha came to the Shunamite, he did not find her busy with anyone else. So she conceived and bore a child through the coming of Elisha.’ (2 Kings 4) The brother said to him, ’What does this mean?’ The old man said, ’If the soul is vigilant and withdraws from all distraction and abandons its own will, then the spirit of God invades it and it can conceive because it is free to do so.’
